frameworkName: Agentic AI Governance Framework (CSA ATF + OWASP) on OCI
frameworkDescription: Automated evidence collection for agentic AI governance aligned with CSA Agentic Trust Framework and OWASP Agentic Top 10 2026 on Oracle Cloud Infrastructure

oracleCloudServices.governance: OCI Generative AI Agents + AI Guardrails

controls.name: Agent Identity Verification
controls.description: All agents must have verified IAM identities

sourceKeyword.keywordValue: SELECT * FROM oci_logging WHERE resource_type = 'agent' AND event_type = 'identity_verification'
SELECT * FROM oci_iam_policies WHERE statement LIKE '%deny%' AND principal_type = 'agent'

controls.name: IAM Policy Enforcement
controls.description: IAM policies must be enforced for all agent actions

sourceKeyword.keywordValue: SELECT * FROM oci_logging WHERE resource_type = 'agent' AND event_type = 'policy_evaluation'
SELECT * FROM oci_logging WHERE service = 'zpr' AND event_type = 'policy_evaluation'

controls.name: AI Guardrails Enforcement
controls.description: AI Guardrails must be enforced for all agent interactions

sourceKeyword.keywordValue: SELECT * FROM oci_logging WHERE service = 'generative_ai' AND event_type = 'guardrail_evaluation'
SELECT * FROM oci_logging WHERE service = 'generative_ai' AND event_type = 'content_moderation'

controls.name: Prompt Injection Protection (PI)
controls.description: Prompt Injection protection must be enabled

sourceKeyword.keywordValue: SELECT * FROM oci_logging WHERE service = 'generative_ai' AND event_type = 'prompt_injection'
SELECT * FROM oci_logging WHERE service = 'generative_ai' AND event_type = 'pii_detection'

controls.name: Centralized Logging
controls.description: All agent actions must be logged to OCI Logging

sourceKeyword.keywordValue: SELECT * FROM oci_logging WHERE service = 'vcn' AND resource_type = 'agent'

controls.name: Data Retention
controls.description: Logs must be retained for 10 years

controls.name: ASI01 — Agent Goal Hijack
controls.description: Prevent goal hijacking using Prompt Injection guardrails

sourceKeyword.keywordValue: SELECT * FROM oci_logging WHERE service = 'generative_ai' AND event_type = 'prompt_injection' AND action = 'BLOCK'

controls.name: ASI02 — Tool Misuse
controls.description: Prevent tool misuse using IAM policies

sourceKeyword.keywordValue: SELECT * FROM oci_logging WHERE service = 'iam' AND event_type = 'policy_denied' AND principal_type = 'agent'

controls.name: ASI03 — Identity & Privilege Abuse
controls.description: Prevent identity abuse using deny-by-default IAM

sourceKeyword.keywordValue: SELECT * FROM oci_logging WHERE service = 'iam' AND event_type = 'unauthorized_access' AND principal_type = 'agent'

controls.name: ASI04 — Resource Exhaustion
controls.description: Prevent resource exhaustion using OCI Monitoring

sourceKeyword.keywordValue: SELECT * FROM oci_monitoring WHERE metric_name LIKE '%resource%' AND resource_type = 'agent'

controls.name: ASI05 — Unexpected Code Execution
controls.description: Prevent code execution using Content Moderation

sourceKeyword.keywordValue: SELECT * FROM oci_logging WHERE service = 'generative_ai' AND event_type = 'content_moderation' AND action = 'BLOCK'

controls.name: ASI06 — Memory & Context Poisoning
controls.description: Prevent memory poisoning using PII protection

sourceKeyword.keywordValue: SELECT * FROM oci_logging WHERE service = 'generative_ai' AND event_type = 'pii_detection' AND action = 'REDACT'
